##### Source: Player's Handbook (Misty Step)

*2nd-level manifestation*

**Casting Time:** 1 bonus action

**Range:** Self

**Components:** V

**Duration:** Instantaneous

Briefly digitizing your body, you teleport up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space that you can see.

***Tech Lists.*** [Source Coder](/techs:sourcecoder), [Streamer](/techs:streamer), [Techwizard](/techs:techwizard)
